subclaim: S8 (and S4, through the main geometry)
origem: tests requested in the internal review of the manuscript drafts and adopted on 01/10/2026, with the title 'Estimand Drift under Spatial Block Hold-Out'
pergunta: In the main geometry of the article (g=10 km, b=2 km), in two cities with no territorial overlap (Bauru and Campinas), does the error on the valid nodes of trained models (GNN and MLP of matched effective capacity, same configuration as A3/A4, no chain, 8 epochs) drift between split draws above non-determinism and between-seed variation, and do the two models remain at parity on the sentinels?
desenho: block 1 (priority 1): Bauru Q1 and Campinas Q1, training seed 42, the first 20 split draws of the list of 60 in fase2/2.1_deriva_erro_baselines_16x60rnd.json, GNN and MLP (80 runs). block 2 (priority 2, crossed): Bauru Q1 and Campinas Q1, seeds 43 and 44, the first 5 of these split draws (40 runs; together with block 1 they form 3 seeds x 5 split draws per cell). block 3 (priority 3): Bauru Q3 and Campinas Q3, seed 42, the same 20 split draws (80 runs). Split draw without a valid node in the test set after the buffer: the run is recorded as 'no valid nodes' and is not replaced.
metricas: per cell and model: SD (ddof=1) across split draws of the received-power MAE on the valid test nodes; ratio of that SD to 0.132 dB (largest difference between GNN repetitions, A2c) and to the between-seed SD (block 2); per-cell median of |GNN - MLP| on the sentinels; in block 2, split-draw x seed variance components (two-way ANOVA without replication); per-draw correlation between the model MAE and the constant-predictor MAE on the valid nodes (the split draws are the same as in 2.1).
leitura: SD between split draws >= 3 x 0.132 dB for GNN and MLP in >= 3 of the 4 cells AND split-draw component >= seed component in the 2 cells of block 2 -> REINFORCES: 'trained models leave the drift in place' becomes valid in the main geometry and in two cities; the abstract sentence no longer says 'one city'. SD between split draws < 2 x 0.132 dB in >= 3 cells -> DELIMITS: the text says that with trained models the drift on the valid nodes at 10 km is of the order of training noise, and S8 is restricted to 5 km. Sentinel parity: median |GNN - MLP| <= 0.117 dB (largest difference between repetitions on the sentinels, A2c) in the 4 cells -> keeps the sentence; otherwise the parity sentence is restricted to the 5 km batch.
se_inverter: no outcome inverts the title (which is about the protocol and the fixed predictor); the worst outcome restricts S8.
orcamento: about 14 min per GNN run and 2 min per MLP run (batch A4); blocks 1+2+3 ~ 100 GNN + 100 MLP ~ 27 h of GPU; the blocks are launched in priority order and the batch is resumable; block 1 alone (~11 h) already answers the question in two cities.
